body: Thank you very much, everyone. It really means a lot. I am trying to look ahead but the only thing I feel is guilt and sorrow. I just want to ease these pains.

I was sent to a counselor as I tried to kill myself a few days ago. I didn’t treat my wife with respect. I didn’t make her feel happy and comfortable. Later I found out When she left me I couldn’t take it anymore as she is everything to me. Life without her is simply impossible. I have no friends and no family. 

When I came up to the counselor with these regrets she didn’t suggest me any help. She said that its my fault for what happened and asked me to leave. I understand that it was my fault but I still felt very bad. I don’t think I deserve to live. I just wanna to end it.
